Now, in relation to that also, we have Rule 9 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 6713 providing actually and explicitly providing For the elements of conflict of interest to arise and the necessity of divestment. In fact, this is provided under Section 1, Subparagraph B of Rule 9 of RA 6713, Implementing Rules and Regulations. And I will read just for the record and so that the public may also hear. Under Section 1, Subparagraph B, conflict of interest occurs When the official or employee is a substantial stockholder or a member of the board of directors or an officer of the corporation or an owner or has substantial interest in a business or a partner in a partnership and number two, the interest of such corporation or business or his rights or duties therein are opposed to or affected by the faithful performance of official duty. Now, with respect to that conflict of interest, the said implementing rules and regulations, meaning the law, provides that under Section 2, subparagraph B, divestment is mandatory only if all the conditions in Section 1, subparagraph B, All the elements enumerated under the preceding paragraph must first concur before the public official or employee may be required to divest himself of such financial or alleged financial interest in any firm or company.
